cards.rationale: Bad Left Hook describes Ramos-Nursultanov as potentially more competitive than Cruz-Bravo. Nursultanov is an unbeaten 20-0 mandatory challenger, but his first fight since 2023 introduces substantial layoff and market-maturity risk against Ramos, who has settled at middleweight and recently beat Shane Mosley Jr. Paddy Power directly lists Ramos 2/9, draw 16/1 and Nursultanov 7/2 (+350); removing that book's overround makes Nursultanov approximately +395 fair. Broader two-way references range from +340 to +475, but they are not interchangeable with a draw-loses price. The combination of layoff uncertainty, disagreement and draw risk makes +500 the disciplined three-way entry rather than chasing +350.
